The '''Ma'alkerr system''' was located in the [[Rago sector/Legends|Rago sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Ma'alkerrite ape-man]].<ref name="JediDawn" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ma'alkerr [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square I-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
